selection.name: NVIDIA Container Toolkit
selection.role: C09: NVIDIA device and library integration for WSL2 GPU containers. Select the maintained toolkit packaging, including libnvidia-container and its CLI, alongside the rootless container provider.
selection.install_command:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl gnupg2
curl -fsSL https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/gpgkey | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/nvidia-container-toolkit-keyring.gpg
curl -s -L https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/stable/deb/nvidia-container-toolkit.list | sed 's#deb https://#deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/nvidia-container-toolkit-keyring.gpg] https://#g' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nvidia-container-toolkit.list
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-container-toolkit=1.20.1-1 nvidia-container-toolkit-base=1.20.1-1 libnvidia-container-tools=1.20.1-1 libnvidia-container1=1.20.1-1

basis.shows: Latest release verified through releases/latest: v1.20.1, published 2026-09-19. It packages matching toolkit and libnvidia-container releases and includes a WSL2 device-injection correction.
Verified default-branch commit dated 2026-10-01; repository metadata reports archived=false.

Documents NVIDIA CDI generation, Podman device injection, and automatic selection of JIT-CDI mode on WSL2. These establish supported integration mechanisms, not a measured advantage on the target workstation.
Lists tested Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 and 26.04 support on x86_64 and arm64. This is Linux platform evidence; it does not establish native macOS support.
GitHub API check records at the inspected default-branch commit report successful unit, build, packaging and two E2E jobs. Their results do not establish rootless WSL2 RTX 4090 inference performance.
Representative recent issue activity: this issue was closed and updated on 2026-10-01. Recent release, issue and default-branch activity satisfy the maintenance screen.

selection.name: Apptainer
selection.role: C02: Provisional rootless workload provider using the upstream non-setuid Ubuntu installation and documented WSL2 --nv --nvccli route. Its explicit WSL2 GPU recipe supports this selection; the runtime preference remains a close call with Podman CDI.
selection.install_command:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y software-properties-common
sudo add-apt-repository -y ppa:apptainer/ppa
sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y apptainer

basis.shows: Documents non-setuid Ubuntu packages for amd64 and arm64, recommends WSL2 on Windows, and gives a WSL2 GPU recipe installing NVIDIA Container Toolkit and running a TensorFlow container with --nv --nvccli. It also documents macOS execution through Linux VMs, including Lima and an Apple Silicon container-machine option.

Documents unprivileged NVIDIA GPU operation, nvidia-container-cli integration and TensorFlow GPU examples. The nvccli path is labelled experimental and has writable-image and permission requirements that must be validated on the target.
Latest release verified through releases/latest: v1.5.4, published 2026-09-22, with Linux amd64 packages and a fix for rootless image builds on Ubuntu 24.04 and later.
Verified default-branch commit dated 2026-10-01; repository metadata reports archived=false.

Upstream GPU tests cover nvidia-smi, device containment and capability handling. Important limitation: basic nvccli nvidia-smi cases use RootProfile, while some other cases use UserProfile; this suite alone does not prove the requested rootless WSL2 workload.
The public GitHub commit-status record reports this upstream GPU-test pipeline as SUCCESS. Pipeline logs were not inspected, and this is not a head-to-head inference result.
Representative recent issue activity: this open issue was updated on 2026-09-30. This establishes activity, not a measured maintainer response time.
Provides a documented container CLI. Claude Code and Codex usability through exec/run commands is an inference from that CLI, not an upstream agent-client integration evaluation.

not_selected.name: Podman CDI
not_selected.reason: Strong rootless CDI alternative and the principal comparison arm; the inspected evidence does not establish a WSL2 RTX 4090 inference winner. [NVIDIA CDI recipe](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cloud-native-docs/blob/de38d7746df9/container-toolkit/cdi-support.md).

not_selected.name: nerdctl
not_selected.reason: Viable rootless/CDI route requiring containerd and vendor-toolkit setup; no deciding WSL2 GPU comparison was found in the reviewed [GPU guide](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/blob/35a81ab10e66/docs/gpu.md) and [rootless guide](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/blob/35a81ab10e66/docs/rootless.md).

not_selected.name: Moby (Docker Engine)
not_selected.reason: Viable rootless NVIDIA integration requiring Docker-daemon and toolkit configuration; reviewed sources provide less direct WSL2 workload evidence than the selected recipe. [Rootless configuration](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cloud-native-docs/blob/de38d7746df9/container-toolkit/install-guide.md).

not_selected.name: SingularityCE
not_selected.reason: Provides NVIDIA and nvccli container support; the inspected GPU guide supplies less direct evidence for the required rootless WSL2 setup than Apptainer’s explicit WSL2 recipe. [GPU guide](https://github.com/sylabs/singularity-userdocs/blob/main/gpu.rst).

not_selected.name: containerd
not_selected.reason: Maintained runtime infrastructure requiring additional rootless management and NVIDIA integration for this task; the selected pair provides a more direct documented workload path. [Runtime scope](https://github.com/containerd/containerd/blob/eb4dbd872d92/README.md).

not_selected.name: runc
not_selected.reason: Useful OCI execution infrastructure, but selecting it separately leaves the NVIDIA library/device integration and workload-management portions of the requirement to other components. [Runtime scope](https://github.com/opencontainers/runc/blob/97f76a9b4601/README.md).

not_selected.name: crun
not_selected.reason: Its upstream comparison with runc measures generic container startup and memory use, not rootless WSL2 GPU passthrough or inference; it remains an underlying OCI component. [Published measurements](https://github.com/containers/crun/blob/ca7879f42ad5/README.md#performance).

not_selected.name: Container Device Interface (CDI)
not_selected.reason: Relevant device specification and integration library; NVIDIA Toolkit already supplies NVIDIA CDI generation, so a separate CDI repository installation has no demonstrated additional benefit for this host. [CDI scope](https://github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/blob/cb98bcf66dc6/README.md).

not_selected.name: libnvidia-container
not_selected.reason: Required NVIDIA integration machinery already included in the selected toolkit’s unified release; independently assembling the library offers no demonstrated advantage for this clean install. [Unified release](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/releases/tag/v1.20.1).

not_selected.name: No additional component
not_selected.reason: The packet contains no workload inventory or comparison establishing that containers do not need the GPU, so the requirement’s bypass option cannot be justified.

layers.deciding_comparison: The selected pair is a provisional recommendation based on its explicit non-setuid WSL2 GPU recipe; no measured runtime winner is established. Compare Apptainer + NVIDIA Container Toolkit against Podman CDI + the same toolkit on the actual RTX 4090 workstation. Freeze Windows driver, WSL release/kernel, Ubuntu release, repository versions, image digest, inference model and inputs. Each arm must run without host-root privileges, successfully execute nvidia-smi, and execute the same GPU inference workload with device placement verified. Record installation and configuration steps, image conversion where applicable, cold-start failures, writable-image requirements, device/library discovery failures, and repeat-run inference latency and throughput. nerdctl/containerd is a credible additional arm if the first two remain tied.
evidence_gaps: The packet records no comparison where every named arm ran. No reviewed source establishes comparative rootless WSL2 RTX 4090 inference performance; published examples and successful upstream CI are supporting evidence, not that comparison.

The target Windows driver and WSL release are unspecified. The installation commands assume functioning host WSL2 GPU passthrough. Apptainer’s experimental nvccli path, writable-image requirements and privilege profiles require target validation. The PPA’s actual package version was not checked.

Currency does not eliminate any repository candidate: all 11 were non-archived and had verified default-branch commits between 2026-09-04 and 2026-10-02 UTC. Release and recent issue activity were additionally inspected for Toolkit, Apptainer, Podman and nerdctl; issue response times and all other repositories’ release histories were not established.

Podman’s inspected rootless system/integration checks succeeded, although its overall check rollup failed on Zizmor. nerdctl’s Linux rootless checks succeeded, although its rollup included a gomodjail failure. These failures were not treated as evidence of GPU inferiority.

macOS arm64 execution is documented through a Linux VM for Apptainer. NVIDIA Toolkit’s platform evidence concerns Linux; the reviewed sources do not demonstrate the workstation’s NVIDIA GPU path on macOS. Agent-client compatibility is inferred from documented CLIs, with no inspected Claude Code or Codex integration evaluation.

Research used 30 GitHub API calls, including unsuccessful gathers, and attempted four web-search queries. Required ctx_fetch_and_index page fetches were blocked because the MCP tool requires approval while the approval policy is never; no permission request could resolve that in this session. Public upstream documentation was instead retrieved through the permitted GitHub API, indexed with ctx_index and read with ctx_search. Consequently, the requested web-page fetching procedure was not completed.
